info.title: Reclaim API
info.description: Lost-and-found recovery network API (PostgreSQL). Simulated parts are labelled: PayPal orders are mocked until Day 3, the courier is simulated, and extraction falls back to keyword rules when no AI key is configured. `/api/v1/dev/*` needs ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=true.

post.summary: Create an account and sign in. Rate limited per IP.
Sign in. Rate limited per IP and per email.
Submit a draft report (wizard final step)

get.summary: Candidate matches for all of the user's lost reports
Private questions to show on the claim form

post.summary: Approve / reject / escalate (reviewers only, reason required)
Staff: mark ready for pickup (issues pickup code)
Claimant: reveal a one-time pickup code (rotates any previous code). The code is returned only in this response; the server stores just its hash.
Staff: validate pickup code and hand over
Create order from the stored quote; redirect browser to approval_url
Call from the return page with ?token=<paypal_order_id>. Idempotent.
PayPal webhook. Signature verified with PayPal; duplicates are acknowledged and ignored.

get.summary: Participating organisations (for the found-report wizard and org switcher)
Operations table rows (AG Grid). Scoped to the caller's locations.

post.summary: Upload an image (JPEG/PNG/WebP) or PDF evidence, max 8 MB; pass the id in image_ids. Rate limited per user.

get.summary: Readiness: database reachable and migrations applied (503 otherwise)

post.summary: Wipe ALL data and reload the demo seed (signs everyone out). Needs ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=true
Staff: move a dispatched delivery to in_transit now (otherwise automatic after ~20s). Needs ENABLE_DEV_ROUTES=true

AddressOut.title: AddressOut
AddressOut.description: Full for the claimant; staff see recipient name, city and country only.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: AI assistance only. A human reviewer makes the decision.

id.title: Id
id.description: Found report id; use for case detail.

statement.title: Statement
statement.description: Why the claimant believes it is theirs.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Claimant and reviewers only; empty otherwise.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Claimant and reviewers only; empty otherwise.

available_actions.title: Available Actions
available_actions.description: claimant: add_evidence, choose_recovery, view_recovery; reviewer: approve, reject, escalate

approval_url.title: Approval Url
approval_url.description: Redirect the browser here to approve the payment.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. CLAIM_NOT_REVIEWABLE.

is_fallback.title: Is Fallback
is_fallback.description: True when the deterministic (non-AI) extractor produced the result.

custody_status.title: Custody Status
custody_status.description: finder_holds = 'I have the item'; transferred = 'Handed to an organisation'; organisation_holds = staff recording an item their organisation holds (membership required).

found_location.description: Where an individual found it. Required when custody is finder_holds.

storage_reference.title: Storage Reference
storage_reference.description: Staff only. Private; never shown publicly.

url.title: Url
url.description: Same-origin path; send the session cookie to fetch it.

attributes_private.title: Attributes Private
attributes_private.description: Never shown publicly. Used for private verification.

as_draft.title: As Draft
as_draft.description: True keeps the report in `draft` so the wizard can run AI extraction before calling POST /reports/{id}/submit.

score.title: Score
score.description: AI relevance 0-100. Advisory only; not proof of ownership.

ownership_warning.title: Ownership Warning
ownership_warning.default: This is an AI-generated candidate, not proof of ownership.

is_staff.title: Is Staff
is_staff.description: True when the user has at least one organisation membership.

location_ids.title: Location Ids
location_ids.description: Empty means all locations in the organisation.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.

type.title: Type
type.description: match.found, claim.submitted, claim.new_for_review, claim.approved, claim.rejected, claim.escalated, payment.captured, recovery.ready_for_pickup, recovery.dispatched, recovery.in_transit, recovery.completed

is_seeded_demo_data.title: Is Seeded Demo Data
is_seeded_demo_data.description: Show a 'seeded demo data' label when true.

pickup_token.title: Pickup Token
pickup_token.description: Only in the response to POST .../collection/pickup-token (claimant, ready_for_pickup). Null everywhere else: the server stores only a hash. Never show on a public page.

courier_is_simulated.title: Courier Is Simulated
courier_is_simulated.description: Always true for now: label the courier as simulated.

available_actions.title: Available Actions
available_actions.description: claimant: pay_with_paypal, show_pickup_code, confirm_received, cancel; staff: mark_ready_for_pickup, validate_pickup_token, dispatch, cancel

processing_status.title: Processing Status
processing_status.description: AI/matching processing state for the report.

images.title: Images
images.description: Only public_safe images unless viewer is owner/custodian.

storage_reference.title: Storage Reference
storage_reference.description: Null unless viewer is an organisation custodian.

available_actions.title: Available Actions
available_actions.description: Server-decided actions for this viewer: edit, submit, extract, withdraw, view_matches.
